title: Chapter 200 - 200 Move The Car; Reward!

Chapter 200 - 200 Move The Car; Reward!

Chapter 200 - 200 Move the Car; Reward!

200 Move the Car; Reward!

Lin Fan and Qiu Ziqian strolled around SK Mall. They passed by many women’s clothing stores and only glanced at the entrance a few times. They never entered.

“Nothing caught your eye?” Lin Fan asked curiously.

Qiu Ziqian nodded. “There used to be a Chanel shop in SK Mall. Why is it suddenly gone?”

Chanel?

Lin Fan remembered that he had seen this shop when he went to the shopping mall with Lin Xiaoyao and the others.

“I think there’s Chanel in KM Mall,” Lin Fan said.

Then, the two of them went downstairs and headed to KM Mall.

When they arrived at SK Mall, Qiu Ziqian spent a lot of effort parking the car.

In order to avoid trouble, Lin Fan drove the Mini Cooper this time.

On weekends, KM Mall was even more crowded and lively than SK Mall. There were basically no extra parking spaces.

Lin Fan drove around the underground parking lot for a while and saw an empty spot beside the elevator. Without any hesitation, he turned the steering wheel and smoothly parked the car.

Honk, honk!

At this moment, a white Mercedes-Benz drove over and honked at Lin Fan and Qiu Ziqian.

The underground parking lot was enclosed, and the sound of car horns was loud.

Lin Fan frowned.

However, he did not pay too much attention to it. He held Qiu Ziqian’s hand and prepared to leave.

Bang!

At this moment, the door of the Mercedes-Benz suddenly opened and a woman in high heels got out.

“I honked for a long time! Didn’t you hear? Are you deaf?”

Lin Fan’s face darkened, “What’s with the way you talk?!”

“What’s wrong with the way I talk? Didn’t you see the picture in this parking space? This is my parking space! I honked for a long time, but you ignored me!

“Hurry up and move the car away!” the woman in high heels shouted.

Lin Fan and Qiu Ziqian glanced at the floor of the parking space. Indeed, there was a picture.

Ordinary people could see this picture through the camera footage when reversing.

However, Lin Fan had Professional Driving Skills. Why would he need to look at the camera when parking?

With a simple turn of the steering wheel, he could park perfectly in the parking space.

Therefore, he did not notice the picture in the parking space.

If this woman had spoken to him nicely, Lin Fan might have given up the parking space.

However, at this moment, he did not have such thoughts.

Lin Fan said, “There are no parking spaces for rent or sale in KM Mall. Do you think that just by drawing a picture, you can claim a parking space? What a joke! I won’t move my car today. Let’s see what you can do!”

When the high-heeled woman heard this, she was furious and shouted, “What I’ll do? Good, good! When I call security, I’ll see if you still dare to say this!”

At this moment, a middle-aged man in a suit walked over.

The woman in high heels saw this and said happily, “Third Uncle, you came at the right time! This person is occupying my parking space. Hurry up and call security to chase him away.”

The man in the suit looked in the direction the woman in high heels was pointing at and immediately became serious.

The man in a suit was a senior executive at KM Mall.

A few days ago, he was standing at the door with the general manager, Yuan Hong, and the others to send Lin Fan off.

After that, he asked around and found out that Lin Fan was the real owner of the mall.

Therefore, the man in the suit had been looking for an opportunity to please Lin Fan.

However, he did not even have the chance to meet him, let alone fawn over him.

Today, they finally met!

Lin Fan said calmly, “Really? Then I’ll wait for the security guards to chase me away.”

The man in the suit recognized Lin Fan. With Lin Fan’s scanning ability, he naturally recognized him.

However, Lin Fan did not mind at all.

“Do you think I’m joking? You’ll cry later!”

The high-heeled woman was already used to being arrogant. At this moment, when she saw that her third uncle was here, she was even more fearless.

Chase Lin Fan away?

Make Lin Fan cry?

The man in the suit’s face turned pale, and his body trembled.

“Third Uncle, what’s wrong? Quickly call the security guards over. This kind of person should be taught well…”

“Shut up!”

The high-heeled woman spoke again, but before she could finish, the man in the suit interrupted her. At the same time, he raised his hand and slapped her face.

A crisp sound echoed in the underground parking lot.

This slap stunned the high-heeled woman.

Then, the man in the suit ignored her.

He quickly bent down and said in a panicked voice, “M-Mr. Lin… I’m sorry. I didn’t discipline her well…”

“Mr. Lin!” A surprised voice sounded from afar.

General Manager Yuan Hong, who was wearing a white shirt, hurried over.

“Hello, Mr. Lin!”

Lin Fan glanced at Yuan Hong and pointed at the camera not far away. “You’ll know what happened when you look at the surveillance footage later. I’ll leave it all to you to handle.”

Yuan Hong could easily hear the unhappiness in Lin Fan’s tone. His heart tightened, and he quickly said, “Don’t worry, Mr. Lin. I’ll take care of everything.”

Lin Fan nodded his head casually. Then, he held Qiu Ziqian’s waist and strode into the elevator.

After Lin Fan left, Yuan Hong’s face darkened. He looked at the man in the suit with an extremely cold gaze.

The man in the suit trembled and stuttered, “G-General Manager, let me explain…”

“You don’t have to explain. I’ll look at the surveillance footage myself!” Yuan Hong said coldly.

…

At this moment, Lin Fan and Qiu Ziqian arrived on the fourth floor.

Qiu Ziqian looked at Lin Fan in confusion.

It was as if she was saying… ‘Why were those people so afraid of you?’

Lin Fan seemed to have sensed Qiu Ziqian’s doubts and said, “I’m the owner of KM Mall.”

Silence.

Qiu Ziqian felt that the surroundings were suddenly silent.

The first time she saw Lin Fan, Qiu Ziqian knew that Lin Fan was very impressive.

Therefore, she tried her best to guess Lin Fan’s family background and chose to follow him.

Until now…

Qiu Ziqian realized that she had underestimated Lin Fan.

He was the owner of the Imperial Hotel, had 5% of LV’s shares, 51% of Yinshan Group’s shares, 51% of Xiao Wu Wholesale City’s shares, and was the owner of KM Mall…

At this moment, the two of them had already arrived in front of Chanel’s clothing store.

“Ziqian, what clothes do you want?” Lin Fan asked.

Qiu Ziqian finally came back to her senses.

It had to be said that Chanel was indeed an internationally renowned brand. Whether it was the style or the workmanship, everything was very good.

Coupled with Qiu Ziqian’s perfect figure, her overall appearance made Lin Fan admire her.

Hence, Lin Fan specially bought more than ten different designs.

…

On the 25th floor of a residential building in Yi Ke City.

Qiu Ziqian looked at the new clothes in her wardrobe, and her pretty face slowly became sweet.

“Darling, thank you.”

Lin Fan chuckled. “How do you want to thank me?”

“Darling, how do you want me to thank you?” Qiu Ziqian pretended not to understand.

“The imported candy from last time was pretty good. Let’s have another one,” Lin Fan said.

Qiu Ziqian answered and tore open a candy, putting it into her mouth.

Then, she moved closer to Lin Fan.
